plan.failureSummary: Cached deterministic replay failed to find the 'Last Name' input field because the survey form rendered a different field layout ('Your Name', 'Contact Email').
observedIndicators: Failure occurred inside the cache replay file .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js.
Failure screenshot shows form fields 'Your Name' and 'Contact Email' instead of the cached 'Last Name' field.
usedDeterministicMode is true and isRetryAttempt is false.
Overall objective is semantically flexible and easily satisfied by fresh autonomous exploration.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry test
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for tests/unstable-survey.test.ts and re-run the test to allow autonomous interaction with the live form layout.

additionalDataRequests.description: Review if the survey layout intentionally changes dynamically across runs as described in the test objective.

plan.notes: The test description explicitly notes that form layouts shift between loads. The cached replay locked onto selectors from a previous variant with 'Last Name', failing against the current DOM variant. Clearing the page.ai cache and running an autonomous attempt will adapt to the current form fields.
